content.short: Gas-sponsored swap on Stable so users can trade without holding the gas token first.
content.description: GASSSS removes the need to hold gas before your first transaction. Using EIP-7702-style account features, it sponsors fees for swaps between Stable-native assets such as USDT0 and STABLE, so a new user with stablecoins can trade straight away. Sponsorship currently works with supported wallets, starting with Bitget Wallet.
content.meta: Swap USDT0 and other Stable assets without holding gas, as GASSSS sponsors the fee through EIP-7702 accounts.
